dropped.deevo-abcd: DEEVO turns ABCD dialogues into its own recommendation task (customer profile and history -> pain point, objective, strategy and next action chosen from option lists, Appendix A.4); the input construction, label set and test split are unpublished and no code is released. ABCD's own intent or action labels would be a different task.
dropped.mipro-hover: Faithful scoring needs multi-hop retrieval over the 5.2M-document Wikipedia 2017 abstracts corpus (608 MB compressed; the BM25 index used by GEPA/DSPy is several GB in memory). This exceeds the package's data and memory limits, and a reduced corpus would change the retrieval difficulty, so it is not a faithful proxy.
dropped.mind-evolution-stegpoet: The 346 StegPoet instances (101 validation, 245 test) are unreleased and the paper gives only ranges for their generation (message length 10-30, mean gap B 3-7) without the number vocabulary, repetition schedule, topics, styles or answer format; a locally generated instance set would be a new benchmark rather than the paper's.
dropped.rqgm-paper-writing: The APReS writer dataset (titles and abstracts) is unreleased and three of the four panel reviewers are evolved agents that are not published. A single fixed LLM reviewer scoring LLM-written papers is not a faithful proxy; RQGM itself documents reviewer self-preference in exactly this setting.
dropped.darwinian-evolver-vet-code-verification-: Imbue's blog reports end-to-end optimization of its Vet verifier but publishes neither the fitness definition nor the training or evaluation corpus; the public darwinian_evolver repository (commit 7f12365d) contains only different demonstration problems.
dropped.polymath-axi-hardware-module-configurati: The industrial inputs (block diagram, ~100-page datasheet) and golden answers are private.
dropped.constitutional-evolution-multi-agent-soc: No public code or environment: the gridworld society (resource gathering, team projects, Overseer elimination) and its Societal Stability Score are described only in prose.
dropped.cocoevo-deveval-real-world-function-comp: DevEval needs per-repository execution environments (dependencies of many real repositories) and repository-level tests; CoCoEvo's selected subset is not released separately.
dropped.rqgm-polyglot-coding: Aider Polyglot needs six language toolchains (C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust) and RQGM's agentic editing harness; not available on this CPU-only, Python-only package.

rqgm-olympiad-proof-grading.reason: RQGM anchors its grader on 100 held-out IMO-GradingBench items scored by exact match and normalized MAE, the protocol of the Hyperagents IMO grading domain it builds on; with no separately published RQGM split, the evaluator and parameters would be identical.

rqgm-paper-reviewing.reason: RQGM's APReS splits are unreleased; the only public APReS-derived accept/reject data is Hyperagents' OpenReview subset, which would give the same evaluator and parameters as the Hyperagents task.

rqgm-olympiad-proof-writing.reason: RQGM's 20 IMO problems are not identified and two of its three panel graders are unpublished evolved agents; the only public route, IMO-ProofBench proofs graded by a ProofAutoGrader-style judge, is that task's evaluator.
